hero.eyebrow: Career coach for people in tech
hero.headline: Land the offer, not just the interview.
hero.sub: Ten years as a tech recruiter. Now I help engineers and product managers tell their story, get through the loop and negotiate like they mean it.

items.title: Resume and LinkedIn rewrite
items.text: Built around the roles you want, not the ones you had.

items.title: Mock interviews
items.text: Real questions, honest feedback, recorded for you.

items.title: Salary negotiation
items.text: A script for every stage, from recruiter call to offer.

items.title: Career change plan
items.text: Moving into product or design? We map the bridge.

sections.title: The Interview Sprint
sections.text: Three 60-minute sessions over two weeks: your story, a full mock loop, and a negotiation script for the offer.
Sam's negotiation script got me $22k more than the first offer. Best money I've spent on my career.

items.q: Do you work with new grads?
items.a: Yes. The resume rewrite and mock interviews work at any level.

items.q: What if I don't get an offer?
items.a: Sprint clients get a free follow-up session after their next three interviews.
